# Jorge Aranda López, PMP® — Game Production & Pitch Consultant

   > Former Producer at Cloud Imperium Games (Star Citizen, Squadron 42) and PMP®-certified Consulting Producer. Helping indie and AA game studios turn prototypes into publisher-ready $1M–$10M pitch packages, 36-month P&L models, and de-risked production roadmaps.

   ## Core Services (EUR, excl. VAT)
   - Free 20-Minute Pitch Readiness Call (€0): https://cal.com/jorge-aranda-lopez-d3vboo/free-call
   - Budget & Scope Red-Flag Review (€250): 75-minute working audit of pitch deck and P&L sheet + 1-page action list.
   - Pitch & Diligence Readiness Audit (From €1,900): 2-week scope, pipeline, financial break-even, and SteamDB/Boxleiter comp audit.
   - Turnkey Diligence Package & Roadmap (From €4,500): 15-20 page Publisher Pre-Read, 36-month Gantt/hiring plan, and risk register.
   - Fractional Executive Producer (From €2,500/mo): Official pitch co-signer, weekly internal leadership syncs, and publisher milestone governance.
